user_guide.title: User Guide
user_guide.description: Detailed documentation on how to use the DIGISPORTS software

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: DIGISPORTS is a professional software solution for managing, controlling, and scoring sports/martial arts tournaments.
steps: Conduct refereeing & scoring using specialized Scoreboards (Combat, Forms, Musical Forms).
Tournament management: Enter athlete data, draw schedules, create brackets.
LAN synchronization to connect two internal computers during the tournament.
Data safety & protection throughout the event.
Output Real-time result display for the audience and livestreaming.

sections.title: Supported Scoreboard Systems
sections.content: The system supports 3 major scoreboard modules:
steps: Combat Scoreboard: Manage rounds, warnings, point deductions, video reviews.
Forms Scoreboard (DOL, SOL, TUV, DAL): Score technique, performance, calculate average points.
Musical Forms Scoreboard: Score multi-athlete routines based on rhythm and audio.

sections.title: Hardware System Requirements
sections.content: To ensure stable software usage, the following infrastructure is required:
steps: Server (Control Center): Windows 10/11 or macOS, minimum 4GB RAM.
Network Connection: Dedicated local LAN/WiFi network with a strong and stable router.
Judging Devices (Clients): Tablets or smartphones scanning QR codes.
Browser: Latest version of Google Chrome is recommended on all devices.

sections.title: Local LAN Network Setup
sections.content: For the smoothest and safest scoring system, an independent router is needed:
steps: Equip a powerful WiFi Router (Supporting 5GHz or WiFi 6).
Only allow the main Server and Judging mobile devices to connect to this local network.
Disconnect external Internet access to avoid bandwidth congestion and interference.

sections.title: Starting the Main Server
sections.content: Launch the software from the primary computer (Server):
steps: Plug in the USB containing the DIGISPORTS app or launch the Desktop Shortcut.
Carefully check the Port status, e.g., System running at IPv4: http://192.168.1.5:3000.
Click 'Start' on the Launcher interface.

sections.title: Obtain Connection QR Code
sections.content: Provide access permissions to scoring devices (Clients):
steps: Go to the Connection Management screen (on the left sidebar menu).
The Server provides a secure QR code or direct path (IP:Port).
Arrange Tablets/Phones for judges to scan this QR code.

sections.title: Tournament Creation & Drawing
sections.content: Configure participant lists and match brackets:
steps: Go to 'Tournament Management', create new or select an existing tournament.
Set up competition categories or weight classes.
Import lists from Excel templates or manually add athletes.
Use the random drawing tool to divide brackets.

sections.title: Athlete Management
sections.content: Manage information, medical checks, and weigh-ins:
steps: Update athlete weights and delegations from the grid menu.
Verify eligibility before allowing an athlete into the match.

sections.title: Schedule & Brackets
steps: Display matches in a professional Bracket layout for combat sports.
Drag and drop to reschedule matches, print schedules in A4.

sections.title: Scoring DOL/SOL/TUV/DAL (Forms)
steps: Click 'Enter Match' from match list
Press F1 to open device connection management
Register judge permissions for each device (J1, J2, J3...)
Click 'Start' to begin the match
Judges enter scores on mobile devices by 5 criteria:
• Movement (0-10)
• Technique (0-10)
• Power (0-10)
• Spirit (0-10)
• Overall (0-10)
System calculates average (removing high/low if configured)
Click 'Finish' to save results
Click 'Report' to view/print competition report

sections.title: Scoring VON (Martial Arts Music)
steps: Click 'Enter Match' from match list
Press F1 to open device connection management
Register judge permissions for each device
Click 'Start' to begin the match
Judges enter scores by 4 criteria:
• Movement (0-10)
• Technique (0-10)
• Music (0-10)
• Overall (0-10)
System calculates average
Can exclude athletes from scoring if needed
Click 'Finish' to save results
Click 'Report' to view/print competition report

sections.title: Scoring DK (Combat)
steps: Click 'Enter Match' from match list
Configure: Rounds (1-3), round time (1-3 mins)
Connect judging devices and assign permissions
Click 'Start' to begin the match
Use scoring buttons:
• +1, +2, +3 for Red or Blue
• Fall: Record when athlete falls
• Warning: Penalize violation
• Reminder: Athlete reminder
System tracks time and calculates points automatically
Can pause, use rest time, or medical time
Click 'Finish' and select winner
Results saved automatically to database

sections.title: Referee Role Assignment
sections.content: Assign specific roles to each external device connected to the system:
steps: Open Connection Management, monitor IP addresses of successfully connected devices.
Select a specific device to assign permissions: Referee 1, 2, 3... or Control Screen.
Lock routing to prevent unexpected disconnections.

sections.title: Multi-Screen Synchronization
sections.content: Configure Screen for external connection display:
steps: Go to Secondary Display module.
Drag the secondary window to TV or LED screen via HDMI/DisplayPort.
The system will synchronize scoreboards and sponsor names to the LED screen instantly.

sections.title: Result Export (Minutes)
sections.content: Print A4 match minutes after each completed session:
steps: The system pins the list of completed matches in the Reports module.
Select the report type corresponding to the discipline.
Fill in Chief Referee, Judge signature information.
Click 'Print Report' to save PDF or connect to laser printer.

sections.title: Delegation Ranking Summary
steps: Instantly summarize Gold - Silver - Bronze results for each unit.
Export to Excel quickly for press and organizers.
History is fully retained for post-checking.

sections.title: Handling Disconnected Judging Devices
sections.content: Ways to fix when assessing devices lose connections:
steps: Review the WiFi Router, avoid 2.4GHz interference from public networks.
Access Connection Management on the Server, remove old device entries, and rescan the QR Code.
Ensure all Tablets are fully charged and screen sleep mode is disabled during tournaments.

sections.title: LAN Sync Issues
sections.content: Resolving errors when LAN Sync cannot transmit points:
steps: Disable Firewalls temporarily on the hosting computer (e.g., Windows Defender).
Ensure the application is run with Administrator rights on Windows, or Root privileges on macOS.
Double-check static IPs for sending and receiving machines.

sections.title: Database Security Concerns
sections.content: The system auto-secures data, however, keep in mind:
steps: Always use an external USB Token to copy Data Backups after each morning/afternoon session.
Provide limited account permissions for data entry participants.
